blockers.finding: PPB1 allows match_threshold at 0 or 2, but P_NEAR_POSITIVE requires a distance strictly between 0 and threshold while both negative classes require room above threshold. The five probe classes are not reachable for every currently admissible config.
blockers.required_correction: Bind one pre-execution threshold corridor strictly inside 0 and 2 plus finite positive near-negative and far-negative margins.

blockers.required_correction: Define a behavioral explanation subset limited to recognized decisions and nearest distances; compare resource and provenance metadata separately.
